row.proto: int (void *rf, uint8_t kind, uint32_t stat_key, uint32_t unused)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Two-level hash lookup (stat key swapped to ushort at rf+0x2b0, then kind byte at obj+0x30) and sums the int values (+4) of the matching bucket records (0x60-byte entries); returns 0 if either key is absent. Used by renown/form refresh to total renown points of one event kind.

verify.notes: V9621 Two-level hash lookup (16-bit stat key then kind byte), sums int at +4 over 0x60-byte records of the bucket; returns 0 if either missing.
